extracted.name: Fried Wonton w/Homemade Sauce & Fried Rice
ingredient_lines: 1 kg ground lean pork, beef, or chicken
1/2 lb peeled fand deveined shrimp, finely chopped
1/4 cup finely chopped spring onions / chives
Easy fried Rice - 4 cups cooked rice, 1 cup chorizo, 3 eggs, carrots, cabbage, green onions
instruction_lines: Mix the first 10 ingredients together for your wonton. Put about 1 tsp of wonton mix to the wrapper and fold. Heat up oil for deep frying start fryihhng your wonton in batches.

While your wonton is frying you can prepare the sauce by putting all the ingredients in a pan and keep mixing until it becomes more thick. Either pour the sauce over the wontons after you put them on a plate or use it as a dipping sauce.
To cook the fried rice just mix all ingredients together.
